description: This is a Python script designed as a CLI utility to extract operationIds from OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, supporting both JSON and YAML formats. It loads the spec, iterates through the defined API paths and methods, and outputs the operationIds with associated HTTP methods and paths.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] load_spec(filepath: str)
methods.description: Loads an OpenAPI or Swagger spec from a JSON or YAML file, with fallback logic based on file extension and content structure.

methods.name: Iterable[Tuple[str,str,str]] extract_operations(spec: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Extracts operationId, method, and path triples from the loaded spec, synthesizing IDs when missing.

methods.name: Iterable[Tuple[str,str,Dict[str,Any]]] _iter_operations_from_paths(paths: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Iterates over paths to yield HTTP method, path, and operation object.

methods.name: int _print_results(ops: Iterable[Tuple[str, str, str]])
methods.description: Prints out discovered operations and returns the count.

methods.name: int main(argv: list[str])
methods.description: Main entry point for the script to parse arguments, load the spec, extract operations, and display results.

ctags.name: _iter_operations_from_paths
ctags.pattern: /^def _iter_operations_from_paths(paths: Dict[str, Any]) -> Iterable[Tuple[str, str, Dict[str, Any/

ctags.name: extract_operations
ctags.pattern: /^def extract_operations(spec: Dict[str, Any]) -> Iterable[Tuple[str, str, str]]:$/

ctags.name: yaml
ctags.pattern: /^    yaml = None  # Will error nicely if YAML is needed but package missing$/

fields.name: yaml = None  # Will error nicely if YAML is needed but package missing
